result.title: Beyond Multimodal Emotion Conflict: Temporal Context-Aware Hidden Emotion Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models
result.summary: Multimodal emotion recognition commonly combines textual, acoustic, and visual signals to infer affective states. Recent work has begun to study conflicts among modalities, but a conflict does not necessarily indicate that a person is concealing an emotion. It may also result from mixed emotions, individual expressive styles, or contextual factors. This proposal aims to distinguish ordinary emotional inconsistency from emotion concealment and to infer the underlying emotion when supported by evidence. We plan to construct a multimodal benchmark with explicit annotations of expressed emotion, internal emotion, and concealment conditions, and to develop an MLLM-based framework that integrates fine-grained facial Action Units (AUs), cross-modal features, and temporal context.

AI.brief_summary: 研究计划：拟构建显式标注「表达情绪／内部情绪／掩饰条件」的多模态基准，并开发融合面部 Action Units、跨模态特征与时间上下文的 MLLM 框架，用于区分普通情绪不一致与情绪掩饰，并在有证据支持时推断隐含情绪。
AI.relevance_reason: 「由可观测信号推断被掩饰的隐含状态」与 latent 假设表示、证据筛选和推断终止有概念联系，可供核查其是否可借鉴到 LVR 的内部状态刻画；但属情感计算应用且仅为提案，未涉及 latent reasoning 机制。
